status: Finite exploratory extension specified after earlier cohort results were inspected, before scoring the present definitions; not preregistration and not an untouched external validation
main_question: Can a module direction learned from measured neutrophil percentages connect the original frozen AD score to measured immune variation, and help audit transport failure?
anchored_direction: Use the locked Stage53 neutrophil predictor's eight module coefficients divided by their saved module feature scales, with no refitting or sign reversal. Age/sex terms are not transferred to AD arrays.
RNA_measurement_link: Calculate original-AD-weighted relative module projection using original AD coefficients/scaler scales on source-standardized RNA module scores. This is a relative shared-module projection, never an AD probability or AD diagnosis in non-AD cohorts.

RNA_cohorts.external: Stage54 Sound Life94 earliest eligible records, previously evaluated healthy cohort

measurement_association_adjustment: Residual-rank association after age rank, male, sex-missing; source additionally adjusts COVID. Four primary descriptive comparisons: AD-weighted projection and module-only neutrophil direction in two cohorts; BH across these four. M01/M07 associations are a separate four-test diagnostic family.
array_mapping_boundary: Original AD-array module inputs remain on their original discovery-defined scale. The frozen RNA-derived module direction is transferred only as an exploratory direction index. No percentage prediction, target centering, gene-scale adaptation or inferred measured CBC label is claimed.
support_decomposition: On all330 original discovery profiles, retain the original module covariance and mean. For b=frozen measured-neutrophil module coefficient direction and delta=M-mu: Dimmune=(b^T delta)^2/(b^T Sigma b), Dresidual=Doriginal-Dimmune. This is a mathematical one-dimensional decomposition, not a causal or technical-artifact partition.
score_orientation: Accept smaller distance or uncertainty; no reversal after seeing labels; stable sample-ID tie-breaking
source_gate: 95th empirical percentile of source330 scores, descriptive fixed threshold only; not a conformal guarantee
gain_comparison: At fixed80% coverage, compare retained Brier of the anchored residual with each of original drift and frozen uncertainty in both cohorts. Reselect retained records in each stratified bootstrap draw.
pilot_gate: All four paired gain CI lower bounds exceed0 at80% coverage; still exploratory even if passed
error_context_association: Within AD and control separately, report residual-rank association of the signed immune-direction index with squared prediction error after age and sex. Labels are used for descriptive stratification, not fitting a gate. Combined diagnosis-adjusted inference is a sensitivity result and not proof of causal immune-induced errors.
expanded_confounding_audit: Before present scoring, inspection of clinical field availability confirmed GSE140829 batch and APOE genotype. Add a prespecified sensitivity adjustment for batch categorical fixed effects, APOE E4-allele count and APOE-missing indicator; do not fill missing genotype from diagnosis. Use an additional within-batch descriptive resampling check when both AD and control remain estimable. These variables do not enter a new classifier or score.
uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fixed source model/reference; sample resampling in AD arrays cannot establish unknown donor independence or population generalization. Already inspected cohorts are not new test cohorts.
stop_rule: No new score mixture, sign, centering, gene list, coverage, covariate or threshold search after present results; report all preset failures
claims_not_established: causal immune driver of triage error
